contest.measure_text: Shall the ordinance maintaining City of Monterey Park's services like fire, police, 911 response; keeping public areas safe/clean; helping prevent property crimes/human trafficking in Monterey Park; repairing streets/potholes; for other city services; by increasing the transient occupancy tax paid only by hotel/motel guests from 13% to 14%, and short-term rental guests, from 13% to 16%, providing approximately $600,000 annually until ended by voters; requiring audits, spending disclosure, local control over all funds, be adopted? Supporters: Henry Lo, Mayor; Jose Sanchez, Pro Tem; Thomas Wong, Councilmember; Vinh Ngo, Councilmember; Elizabeth Yang, Councilmember Opponents: None submitted.
contest.office: CITY OF MONTEREY PARK GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION - MEASURE AAA
